Verifier notes and special checks

Forty-six printed bars, each a full bar of six eighths in 6/8 with two flats. The upper staff opens in treble and the lower staff in bass; later systems only reprint those clefs, and no clef change is printed. There is no pickup, repeat, ending, or meter or key change. Systems 8 and 10 were checked on the print and agree with the proposed barlines. The last bar ends with a light-heavy final barline and fermatas, and its written values still fill one bar. Systems 1–7 and 9 were already verified on these pixels and are copied unchanged.

  • System 10, last bar: Does the thick stroke after the thin stroke add another bar? No. The thin stroke at crop x 1401 and the thick stroke from crop x 1408 to 1415 are one light-heavy final barline.
  • System 8, near the middle of the first and third bars: Are the long verticals near crop x 443 and 903 barlines? No. Each is a note stem on the upper staff and a separate note stem on the lower staff, with a clear gap between the staves.
  • System 8, fourth bar, lower staff: Is the small numeral a first ending? No. It is a fingering numeral beside a left-hand chord. No ending bracket is printed.
  • System 10, last bar: Do the fermatas make the last bar unmeasured? No. The lower staff holds a dotted half note and the upper staff has an eighth note plus rests, which fill one 6/8 bar.
  • Page 2 below system 10: Is any musical ink outside the system 10 crop? No. The octave line and pedal marks are inside the crop. The plate number below the crop is not musical ink.
